points.title: 童年与少年时期
points.description: 聂耳出生于昆明一个清贫的中医家庭，原名聂守信。自幼喜爱音乐，自学多种乐器。1927年，他考入云南省立第一师范学校，开始系统学习音乐知识。这一时期，他深受云南民间音乐影响，收集整理了大量民歌素材，为其后来的创作奠定了基础。他还积极参与学生运动，接触进步思想，形成了初步的革命意识。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Kunming to a poor family of a traditional Chinese medicine practitioner, Nie Er was originally named Nie Shouxin. From an early age, he showed a passion for music and taught himself to play various instruments. In 1927, he was admitted to Yunnan Provincial Normal School No. 1, where he began systematic study of music. During this period, he was deeply influenced by Yunnan folk music, collecting and organizing numerous folk songs that laid the foundation for his later compositions. He also actively participated in student movements and came into contact with progressive ideas, forming his initial revolutionary consciousness.

points.title: 求学与革命启蒙
points.description: 1928年，聂耳离开昆明前往上海，先后在私立上海艺术大学和明月歌舞剧社学习。在上海，他接触到更多进步思想，参加了左翼文艺运动。1930年，他加入中国共产主义青年团，开始积极参与革命活动。这一时期，他创作了《开矿歌》等早期作品，表现出鲜明的阶级立场和革命倾向。上海的经历使他的音乐创作与革命思想紧密结合，形成了独特的艺术风格。
points.descriptionEn: In 1928, Nie Er left Kunming for Shanghai, where he studied at private Shanghai Art University and the Bright Moon Song and Dance Troupe. In Shanghai, he was exposed to more progressive ideas and participated in the Left-wing literary and art movement. In 1930, he joined the Communist Youth League of China and began actively engaging in revolutionary activities. During this period, he created early works such as 'Mining Song,' showing distinct class consciousness and revolutionary tendencies. His experiences in Shanghai closely linked his musical compositions with revolutionary thought, forming a unique artistic style.

points.title: 艺术探索与创作高峰
points.description: 1931年，聂耳前往北平（今北京），在北平大学艺术学院学习。在北京期间，他深入研究中国传统音乐和西方音乐理论，创作了《铁蹄下的歌女》、《毕业歌》等著名作品。1932年，他加入中国共产党，成为坚定的革命音乐家。这一时期，他的创作风格逐渐成熟，将民族音乐元素与革命主题完美结合，创作出具有强烈感染力的作品。北京的经历使他的艺术创作达到了一个新的高度，为后来的《义勇军进行曲》奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1931, Nie Er went to Beiping (modern-day Beijing) to study at the Art College of Beiping University. During his time in Beijing, he conducted in-depth research into traditional Chinese music and Western music theory, creating famous works such as 'Singer Under the Iron Heels' and 'Graduation Song.' In 1932, he joined the Communist Party of China, becoming a firm revolutionary musician. During this period, his creative style gradually matured, perfectly combining ethnic musical elements with revolutionary themes to create works with strong emotional impact. His experiences in Beijing brought his artistic creation to a new level, laying the foundation for his later 'March of the Volunteers'.

points.title: 创作巅峰与革命活动
points.description: 1934年，聂耳回到上海，进入百代唱片公司工作，并担任左翼音乐联盟的领导工作。这一时期是他创作的巅峰期，创作了《义勇军进行曲》、《大路歌》、《码头工人歌》等不朽作品。《义勇军进行曲》后来成为中华人民共和国国歌。他还积极参与抗日救亡运动，组织音乐演出，创作了大量反映民族危机和人民苦难的作品。1935年，聂耳在日本藤泽市游泳时不幸溺水身亡，年仅23岁。他的英年早逝是中国音乐界的巨大损失，但他的作品和精神永远激励着后人。
points.descriptionEn: In 1934, Nie Er returned to Shanghai and joined the Pathé Records company, while also serving as a leader of the Left-wing Music League. This period marked the peak of his creative output, producing immortal works such as 'March of the Volunteers,' 'Road Song,' and 'Dockers' Song.' 'March of the Volunteers' later became the national anthem of the People's Republic of China. He actively participated in the anti-Japanese national salvation movement, organizing musical performances and creating numerous works that reflected the national crisis and people's suffering. In 1935, Nie Er tragically drowned while swimming in Fujisawa, Japan, at the young age of 23. His untimely death was a great loss to Chinese music, but his works and spirit continue to inspire future generations.

points.title: 精神传承与纪念
points.description: 聂耳逝世后，他的遗体被运回昆明安葬。昆明建有聂耳纪念馆，成为爱国主义教育基地。他的作品《义勇军进行曲》被定为中华人民共和国国歌，激励了几代中国人。聂耳被誉为'人民音乐家'，他的音乐创作将民族音乐与革命精神完美结合，开创了中国革命音乐的新道路。他的精神遗产不仅体现在音乐创作上，更体现在他短暂而光辉的一生中，展现了一个革命艺术家为民族解放事业奋斗的崇高精神。
points.descriptionEn: After his death, Nie Er's remains were transported back to Kunming for burial. Kunming houses the Nie Er Memorial Hall, serving as a patriotic education base. His composition 'March of the Volunteers' was designated as the national anthem of the People's Republic of China, inspiring generations of Chinese people. Nie Er is honored as 'the People's Musician,' and his musical creations perfectly combined ethnic music with revolutionary spirit, pioneering a new path for Chinese revolutionary music. His legacy is not only reflected in his musical compositions but also in his brief yet brilliant life, embodying the noble spirit of a revolutionary artist fighting for national liberation.

appraisal.zh: 聂耳被公认为中国革命音乐的奠基者，素有「人民音乐家」之称，其《义勇军进行曲》后成为国歌，将民族音乐元素与民族危亡的主题紧密相连，在短暂一生中为中国音乐开辟了与民族命运结合的新方向。也有研究者指出，他的创作政治色彩浓重，形式与技巧相对简朴，集体主义的取向压过了个人情感的探索，加之英年早逝，作品数量与艺术纵深均受限。
appraisal.en: Nie Er is widely recognized as the founder of Chinese revolutionary music and honored as the 'People's Musician'; his 'March of the Volunteers' later became the national anthem, fusing folk idioms with the theme of national crisis and opening a new path linking music to the nation's fate in his brief life. Yet some researchers note that his work is heavily politicized, relatively simple in technique, and weighted toward collectivism over individual feeling, while his early death left a small output and limited artistic depth.

supporter.zh: 聂耳是中国革命音乐的奠基人，被誉为'人民音乐家'。他将民族音乐元素与革命主题完美结合，创作了大量反映民族危机和人民苦难的作品，特别是《义勇军进行曲》成为中华人民共和国国歌，激励了几代中国人。他的音乐作品具有强烈的时代感和民族特色，开创了中国革命音乐的新道路。聂耳短暂而光辉的一生展现了一个革命艺术家为民族解放事业奋斗的崇高精神，他的精神遗产永远激励着后人。
supporter.en: Nie Er is considered the founder of Chinese revolutionary music and honored as 'the People's Musician.' He perfectly combined ethnic musical elements with revolutionary themes, creating numerous works that reflected the national crisis and people's suffering. His 'March of the Volunteers' became the national anthem of the People's Republic of China, inspiring generations of Chinese people. His musical works possess strong contemporary relevance and national characteristics, pioneering a new path for Chinese revolutionary music. Nie Er's brief yet brilliant life embodies the noble spirit of a revolutionary artist fighting for national liberation, and his legacy continues to inspire future generations.

critic.zh: 批评者认为聂耳的创作过于政治化，艺术性受到意识形态的束缚。他的作品虽然具有强烈的革命性，但在艺术形式和技巧上相对简单，缺乏深度和多样性。此外，他短暂的生命使得他的艺术发展未能达到更高层次，作品数量有限。一些评论家也指出，他的音乐创作过于强调集体主义，对个人情感和艺术探索的表达相对不足，这在一定程度上限制了他的艺术成就。
critic.en: Critics argue that Nie Er's compositions were overly politicized, with their artistic value constrained by ideological limitations. While his works possessed strong revolutionary spirit, they were relatively simple in form and technique, lacking depth and diversity. Furthermore, his short life prevented his artistic development from reaching higher levels, resulting in a limited body of work. Some commentators also note that his music emphasized collectivism at the expense of individual emotional expression and artistic exploration, which to some extent limited his artistic achievements.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，聂耳被定义为20世纪中国最重要的音乐家之一，是中国革命音乐的象征性人物。他的作品不仅是艺术创作，更是历史的见证，记录了中华民族最危难时期的抗争精神。在流行文化中，聂耳的形象已超越单纯的艺术家，成为爱国主义和民族精神的象征。他的《义勇军进行曲》作为国歌，已成为国家认同的重要组成部分。历史学界普遍认为，聂耳虽然英年早逝，但他在短暂的生命中为中国音乐的发展开辟了新方向，将音乐与民族命运紧密联系在一起，影响深远。
objective.en: From historical and popular culture perspectives, Nie Er is defined as one of the most important musicians of 20th-century China, a symbolic figure of Chinese revolutionary music. His works are not merely artistic creations but historical testimonies, documenting the fighting spirit of the Chinese nation during its most difficult period. In popular culture, Nie Er's image has transcended that of a simple artist, becoming a symbol of patriotism and national spirit. His 'March of the Volunteers' as the national anthem has become an integral part of national identity. Historiography generally acknowledges that although Nie Er died young, he开辟ed a new direction for Chinese musical development in his brief life, closely linking music with national destiny, with far-reaching influence.

self.zh: 音乐是大众的武器，是唤醒民众、鼓舞斗志的有力工具。
self.en: Music is a weapon for the masses, a powerful tool to awaken the people and boost their morale.
